theoretical_loopholes.name: Common-reference additive cancellation
theoretical_loopholes.result: softmax/winner/row-normalized balanced objective with Delta=c_i-loss is exactly generic loss allocation; entropy/column constraints do not alter the row constant.

theoretical_loopholes.name: Amended-rule equivalence
theoretical_loopholes.result: If all member reference functions equal the frozen pool function, gains P=G pointwise; stop redundant fit.

theoretical_loopholes.name: Weak reference
theoretical_loopholes.result: Raw gains 10-2 versus 1-0.1 favor worse predictor; frozen reference alone does not fix this. Pool cap prevents gains from arbitrarily weak reference above pool loss.

theoretical_loopholes.name: Pool failure
theoretical_loopholes.result: For y=1, reference logits(0,10), native(6,0): member1 qualifies, but uniform pool falls from5 to3.

theoretical_loopholes.name: Remaining interpretation limit
theoretical_loopholes.result: Distinct frozen member thresholds may encode ordinary difficulty; no graph-specific mechanism or utility theorem follows without the matched generic-allocation contrast.
